Fetched the liberty files myself (raw.githubusercontent.com, ORFS at the pinned commit e5cc6e79, plus the 256x64 macro from IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK main, which gives the same 49.6340 pJ read) instead of running fetch_pdk.sh. Grepped all ten IHP macro read scalars (A_MEN&!A_WEN&A_REN) straight from the files: 15.5961 ... 122.3940 pJ, all match section C. The IHP macro header states the internal_power unit as 1e-12 J/toggle (capacitive_load_unit x V^2), which independently confirms the author's pJ reading over the uA x V x ns one. Independent verdict script (scratchpad/ihp/scripts/verdict.py) re-deriving ratio = w_saved/(extra_flops x cycles): 120 cells, ungated WS 92, G=24 WS 120, packed ungated 33/60, max G* 6, all as claimed. Hand: write/read 1.161 (512x64) to 1.293 (64x64), unpacked 460 to 3,610 flop-cycles. Copied a scratch tree with the fetched files and ran experiments/run.py: results.txt byte-identical to the committed one. Not 4 because two method choices (internal power averaged over every when-state and over the whole 0.02-2.5 ns slew axis) are unvalidated against a reference; I checked the first (hold-only D==Q,RESET_B=1 groups give 33.9 fJ too) but not the second (fast-slew entries are about 8% lower).

Defects: fetch_pdk.sh:10 ends the pinned-commit fetch with '|| true', so a failed fetch silently leaves ORFS at master HEAD and the 'pinned' claim is not enforced; min_group_size docstring says strict '<' but ceil gives '<=' at exact integers, and the test comment at tests/test_lib.py:61 says '<='; brace-counting regex parser (_block) has no guard for comments or quoted braces; files opened without close (ResourceWarning in tests); 'import math' inside a function; dead line 'fit = [v for v in verd]' in run.py.
evidence.claims: Every number in README Results checked against results.txt and my recomputation: flop/gate fJ, 1.16-1.29 write/read, 72-497 and 460-3,610 flop-cycles, 1.6-13.0 pJ and 0.05-0.41 pJ thresholds, 92/120, 59/60 unpacked with the 1024x8 L2 B=16 exception, 33/60 packed, the 'from B=4 for four, B=8 for eight' L2 pattern, 28 cells flipped by gating, max G 6. All backed. SKY130 'lost at nearly every packed cell' checked against accel-gatedprice results.json: ungated wins 2 of 32 packed cells, backed. Partial: 'IHP's SRAM is dearer relative to its flops, by about 4 to 8 times when packed' divides range endpoints of different macro sets (72/18, 497/62); for like-width 64-bit macros the ratio is 1.2 to 3.7x. Limitations are honest (clock tree omitted, A_CLK only, macro/layer size confound). Disclaimer on the live page.
evidence.fitness: A researcher can reuse the unit resolution for IHP liberty files and the ten macro read/write energies, which is a real, small contribution. Nearest prior work, none cited in this project: Eyeriss (Chen, Emer, Sze, ISCA 2016) dataflow taxonomy and energy analysis; Timeloop (Parashar et al., ISPASS 2019) and Accelergy (Wu, Emer, Sze, ICCAD 2019), which do exactly this per-action energy pricing from component tables, including PDK-derived plug-ins; CACTI for SRAM energy; Wu and Pedram (clock-gating of sequential circuits) and Horowitz (ISSCC 2014) for the flop/SRAM ratio question. Against that, the result (gate the stationary accumulators; ungated WS depends on the SRAM-to-flop energy ratio) is an expected consequence of the breakeven, not new. It is step nine of a chain of single-README projects with no paper or programme entry in research/PROGRAMMES.md, short of the PhD-level programme bar in research/CLAUDE.md.
evidence.domain: An architect would check the flop energy definition first. Departures: (1) clock tree and wire capacitance omitted; in practice the clock network often costs as much as or more than the flop clock pins, and the ungated verdict is sensitive to it: scaling e_flop and e_icg by 1.5/2/3 drops packed ungated WS wins from 33 to 24/18/12 of 60 (verdict.py). The cross-node flop-cycle comparison survives if overhead scales alike, but the headline 'ungated WS wins about half the packed cells' does not. (2) Internal power averaged over the whole slew index (up to 2.5 ns) rather than at the design's clock slew. (3) Gate priced as idle CLK-pin energy only, no enable logic or area, so G=1 'wins' are not physical. (4) Macro energy is A_CLK only at typ corner, packed is a best case. (5) IHP cells filtered by capacity, SKY130 cells in accel-gatedprice not, so the two nodes' cell sets differ. Each is either disclosed or small, but together a senior reviewer would not sign off the ungated half of the conclusion without a sensitivity sweep.

No sensitivity sweep is reported, so the 'node-dependent' half of the conclusion is not robust as stated

No prior work cited (Eyeriss, Timeloop/Accelergy, CACTI, clock-gating literature, Horowitz 2014); the generalisation result is an expected consequence of the breakeven and novelty is not positioned; no programme or paper

Verdict logic in experiments/run.py and min_group_size rounding have no test that fails on a seeded bug; the only real-data test is skipped by default and nothing pins results.txt (2 of 4 mutations survived)
fetch_pdk.sh '|| true' lets a failed pinned-commit fetch silently fall back to ORFS master HEAD, so reproductions may read different liberty files
'IHP SRAM dearer relative to flops by about 4 to 8 times when packed' divides range endpoints of different macro sets; for comparable 64-bit macros it is 1.2 to 3.7x
min_group_size docstring promises strict '<' but ceil returns G with equality ('<='), and the test comment says '<='
Idle flop energy averages internal power over the full 0.02-2.5 ns input-slew axis instead of the design's clock slew (fast-slew entries ~8% lower); not discussed

verdict: Every number checked is right: an independent liberty reader over files I fetched (ORFS at the pinned commit, and IHP-Open-PDK upstream for one macro) reproduces the IHP and SKY130 flop and gate energies, all ten macro read energies and the 92/120, 33/60, max-G 6 verdict counts, and run.py regenerates results.txt byte for byte. The unit question is settled by the IHP macro header. It falls short of the bar on verification (two of four seeded bugs survive; the verdict code and the real-library path are untested by default) and on research depth: no prior work is cited (Eyeriss, Timeloop/Accelergy, CACTI), and the 'ungated WS is node-dependent' half of the headline is not robust to the omitted clock-tree energy (33 to 18 of 60 packed wins at 2x). A useful, honest data point in a chain, not a publishable result.
